post.description: Admin/Operator, non-demo only. Reads one explicit link parsed from this exact execution's persisted Markdown result. Relative paths use execution_snapshot.cwd; Runner validates current allowed_roots using a capability-relative file open. No directory input, nested-file authorization or persistent content. Text stays bounded to512KiB. Optional image=thumbnail generates a bounded1280px preview on Runner from sources up to32MiB/40MP/16384px per side. image=original returns unchanged original byte chunks: offset, revision, next_offset(null atEOF); every chunk is independently authorized and rejects file changes. Each response fits the existing NATS payload. Old Runners can return small complete images. Response is no-store and nosniff.

Admin/Read-write only. Retries a confirmed failed node in its frozen parent Run, preserving successful nodes and restoring affected descendants under AND. Required nullable execution_id guards stale requests; resume_stopped explicitly recovers graph cancellation/total timeout only after old executions stop. Reuses queued automatic successor. Idempotency-Key returns the same id,parent_run_id,node_id. Node detail exposes retry action, blocking reason and affected descendants.

Operator only. Creates lifecycle metadata; starts only after authenticated WebSocket attachment with dimensions. Optional node_id selects the actual DAG execution. request_id is idempotent. A disconnected terminal may be reattached within 30 seconds; competing writers return 409.

get.description: Same-origin WebSocket. Send {ticket,cols,rows} in the first text frame within 5 seconds. Ticket is single-use and expires after 30 seconds; never place it in the URL. Client frames: heartbeat, input {seq,data:base64}, resize {cols,rows}, snapshot. Server frames: snapshot, output (base64), state, ack, error. Input is never replayed or persisted. One writer; 5-second heartbeat, 30-second disconnect lease.
